quote: 崇重志學，遵敬佛法。伽藍五十餘所，僧徒萬有餘人，並多宗習大乘法教。天祠數十，異道寔多。
note: country description; 'most' (多) study Mahāyāna

quote: 伽藍、天祠及窣堵波，餘址數百，存者二三…是無憂王作地獄處
note: old Pāṭaliputra in ruins: of several hundred monasteries, deva temples and stūpas only 2–3 survive; small town of 1000+ households; Brahmin teacher in the founding legend

quote: 即八萬四千之一也…中有如來舍利一斗…近者設賞迦王毀壞佛法
note: Aśokan stūpa with relics; footprint-stone vihāra; Śaśāṅka's persecution (his religion not named here)

quote: 有大石柱，高三十餘尺…無憂王為近護等諸阿羅漢，役使鬼神之所建立…故別崇建五窣堵波
note: Aśokan inscribed pillar, Mahendra's stone chamber, stone trough, caves for Upagupta; pond called 聖水 by people of neighbouring lands; five stūpas

quote: 頹毀已久，基址尚在…初，此城內伽藍百數…其後僧徒相次徂落
note: Kukkuṭārāma ruined; once hundreds of monasteries in the city; legends of Deva vs. 外道 and Aśvaghoṣa vs. a demon-worshipping Brahmin (祠鬼求福)

quote: 有伽藍餘跡。其傍有窣堵波
note: only remains of a monastery; stūpa still visited by people far and near

quote: 僧徒千數，並學大乘…左多羅菩薩像，右觀自在菩薩像
note: Teladhaka; brass images of Buddha, Tārā and Avalokiteśvara; scholars from abroad

quote: 山頂有大盤石，上建窣堵波，其高十餘尺，是佛入定處也
note: mountain inaccessible to men; stūpa on summit

quote: 僧徒五十餘人，並習大乘法教。瞿那末底菩薩伏外道之處。初，此山中有外道摩沓婆者，祖僧佉之法
note: legend: Guṇamati defeats the Sāṃkhya teacher Mādhava; Mādhava's town households given to the monastery

quote: 尸羅跋陀羅論師論義得勝，捨邑建焉…置佛舍利…南印度有外道
note: Śīlabhadra's monastery on an isolated hill, founded with the town granted after defeating a South Indian 外道

quote: 唯婆羅門有千餘家，大仙人祚胤也…印度相傳謂之聖水
note: Gayā: 1000+ Brahmin families descended from a great ṛṣi, not subject to the king; spring held to be holy water (Hindu tīrtha); no Buddhists mentioned

quote: 印度國俗稱曰靈山…山頂上有石窣堵波，高百餘尺，無憂王之所建也…事火之處
note: Gayā hill: 'spirit mountain' where kings ascend to announce success (登封); Aśokan stūpa; fire-worship sites of the Kāśyapa brothers (legend)

quote: 皆樹旌表，建窣堵波…每歲罷安居日，異方法俗，登修供養
note: Prāgbodhi; annual pilgrimage at the end of the rains

quote: 或窣堵波，或復精舍…令事火婆羅門燒以祠天…近設賞迦王者，信受外道，毀嫉佛法
note: Bodhi-tree enclosure; legends: Aśoka (before conversion) has fire-worshipping Brahmins burn the tree; queen 素信外道; Śaśāṅka 信受外道 destroys tree and monasteries; Pūrṇavarman restores

quote: 不信佛法，事大自在天…置大自在天形…甎壁之前畫自在天
note: Mahābodhi temple: built by a Maheśvara-worshipping Brahmin on the god's advice; Śaśāṅka orders a Maheśvara image to replace the Buddha; Jāguḍa merchant 宗事天神 converted

quote: 西岸有小精舍，中作佛像…林中精舍有佛羸瘦之像
note: Mucilinda pond; emaciated-Buddha image anointed for cures

quote: 棄鹿皮衣，捨祭火具…是如來伏迦葉波所事火龍處
note: series of stūpas; legend of the fire-worshipping Kāśyapa 梵志 converted

quote: 菩提樹垣東門側有窣堵波，魔王怖菩薩之處
note: blind nāga's dwelling; Māra stūpa

quote: 僧徒減千人，習學大乘、上座部法，律儀清肅…故此伽藍多執師子國僧也
note: Mahābodhi saṅghārāma founded by a king of Siṃhala; mostly Sinhalese monks

quote: 其側窣堵波，前建石柱，是昔迦葉波佛於此宴坐
note: gandhahastin jātaka pond

quote: 有石柱，是外道入定發惡願處。昔有外道欝頭藍子者
note: pillar of the 外道 Udraka Rāmaputra (legend)

quote: 渡莫訶河，至大林中，有石柱，是外道入定發惡願處
note: Mahā river; Udraka's pillar

quote: 故今山上建窣堵波
note: Kukkuṭapāda: Mahākāśyapa awaiting Maitreya

quote: 巖間石室，佛嘗降止
note: Buddhavana: cave, fragrant rock; 500 arhats appear as novices

quote: 中有大窣堵波，無憂王之所建也…鄔波索迦闍耶犀那者…凡作七拘胝法舍利窣堵波
note: Yaṣṭivana; recent upāsaka Jayasena (teacher of Xuanzang) making dharma-relic stūpas; visited by śramaṇas, Brahmins and 外道 alike

quote: 有二溫泉…其傍則有窣堵波
note: hot springs created by the Buddha; healing baths

quote: 橫嶺之前有石窣堵波
note: Bimbisāra's stairway

quote: 昔廣博仙人棲隱於此，鑿崖為室，餘趾尚存，傳教門人，遺風猶扇
note: hermitage of the ṛṣi Vyāsa; his teaching tradition still current (遺風猶扇)

quote: 如來在昔於此三月說法…印度謂之阿素洛宮也
note: cave called asura palace; legend of a spell-master (呪術) entering it

quote: 宮城北門外有窣堵波…勝密者，宗信外道，深著邪見
note: old Rājagṛha (Kuśāgrapura); legend of Śrīgupta, follower of 外道, incited by 梵志

quote: 有窣堵波，是時縛迦大醫於此為佛建說法堂
note: Jīvaka's preaching hall

quote: 中路有二小窣堵波
note: Gṛdhrakūṭa approach

quote: 臨崖西埵有甎精舍…今作說法之像
note: brick vihāra with life-size preaching image on Gṛdhrakūṭa

quote: 溫泉左右諸窣堵波及精舍，基址鱗次…隱淪之士蓋亦多矣
note: Vipula hot springs (healing); stūpa and vihāra foundations; many recluses

quote: 今有露形外道，多依此住，修習苦行
note: 露形外道 = naked (Digambara/Nirgrantha) ascetics living on Vipula, turning to follow the sun (Mizutani, ref. his note to juan 1); Pippala cave used by meditating bhikṣus

quote: 傍建窣堵波，是習定比丘自害證果之處
note: Devadatta's cave; stūpas of bhikṣus who attained arhatship by suicide

quote: 今有精舍，石基甎室…今作如來之身
note: Veṇuvana vihāra; legend: grove first given to 外道, expelled by spirits

quote: 阿闍多設咄路王之所建也…有尊者阿難半身舍利
note: Ajātaśatru's relic stūpa (Buddha relics partly removed by Aśoka; half of Ānanda's body)

quote: 有大石室，是尊者摩訶迦葉在此與九百九十大阿羅漢…因而謂之上座部焉
note: First Council cave; origin legend of the name 上座部 (Sthavira) — not a present affiliation

quote: 有窣堵波，無憂王之所建也，大眾部結集之處
note: origin legend of the Mahāsāṃghika (大眾部) council with five piṭakas — not a present affiliation

quote: 如來在昔多此說法…枯涸無餘
note: Kalandaka pond, dried up

quote: 有窣堵波，無憂王所建也，高六十餘尺。傍有石柱
note: inscribed pillar with elephant capital

quote: 以王舍城施婆羅門，故今城中無復凡民，唯婆羅門減千家耳。宮城西南隅有二小伽藍
note: new Rājagṛha given by Aśoka to Brahmins: only <1000 Brahmin families; two small monasteries for visiting monks

quote: 時有善占尼乾外道…僧徒數千，並俊才高學也
note: Nālandā; school not stated in this passage; Nirgrantha (尼乾) diviner at the founding (Mizutani illustrates a Jain image here); several monasteries built by successive kings within one wall

quote: 有銅立佛像，高八十餘尺…有多羅菩薩像
note: Nālandā environs: viharas, Avalokiteśvara and Tārā images, Śīlāditya's brass vihāra, Pūrṇavarman's copper Buddha; legend of a 外道 holding a sparrow

quote: 中有窣堵波，無憂王之所建也，是尊者沒特伽羅子本生故里
note: Maudgalyāyana's birthplace; Bimbisāra's meeting stūpa

quote: 中有窣堵波，無憂王之所建也。是尊者舍利子本生故里…珊闍耶外道
note: Śāriputra's birthplace; Sañjaya called 外道; Long-nailed Brahmacārin (長爪梵志)

quote: 昔此伽藍習翫小乘…大乘者，正理也，宜改先執
note: monastery on the east peak formerly Hīnayāna (三淨 meat allowed), turned to Mahāyāna after the haṃsa legend; present school implied, not stated

quote: 僧徒二百餘人，學說一切有部
note: Kapotaka (pigeon) monastery

quote: 上多精舍靈廟…正中精舍有觀自在菩薩像…香花伎樂供養不絕
note: isolated hill with Avalokiteśvara image, many vihāras and shrines; Siṃhala king's vision; offerings unceasing

quote: 僧徒五十餘人，並學小乘法教
note: monastery 40 li SE of the hill

quote: 有數天祠，並窮彫飾。東南不遠有大窣堵波
note: large prosperous village S of the Ganges with several richly carved deva temples; a stūpa

quote: 伽藍前有大窣堵波，無憂王之所建
note: Lāvaṇīla village; lotus lake
